subject: Demo reschedule — procurement/security gating
messages:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme-corp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo request / procurement gating

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We'd like to schedule a product demo for Redwood Inference to understand how your platform could fit our needs for inference at Acme. Procurement/legal has a couple of gating items on our side they need completed before any external demo with vendors:

- NDA signed by both parties
- Vendor onboarding form (security questionnaire) + SOC2 report or equivalent

Our preferred window is next week (Oct 8-12). Do you have any availability? If it's helpful, I can loop in our procurement lead (Priya) to coordinate the paperwork.

Alex
Alex Jenkins
Head of AI Platform, Acme Corp
alex.jenkins@acme-corp.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + demo request / procurement gating

Thanks Alex — happy to run a demo. I hear you on procurement gating. To speed things along we usually share a lightweight mutual NDA and our standard security questionnaire. I attached our NDA template here for legal to review.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Oct 9, 10:00-11:00
- Fri Oct 10, 14:00-15:00

If procurement needs the vendor onboarding form first, no problem — once we have the signed NDA and the questionnaire back we can lock the demo. I've CC'd Marissa (solutions) and Rishi (SE) so they're aware of the gating items.

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_Template.pdf (attached)

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Priya Menon <priya.m@acme-corp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme-corp.com>, Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + demo request / procurement gating

Hi Vanessa / team,

Quick update from procurement/legal: we need the NDA signed by Redwood before we can circulate our security questionnaire to the vendor team for completion. I've attached the signed NDA (see Acme_NDA_Signed.pdf) and the latest questionnaire template for your security team to review (security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx).

Because this introduces a small delay on our side (legal is back on Oct 8), we'd like to move the demo to Mon Oct 12 if that works for your team. Please confirm availability and whether you can pull in a solutions engineer to cover integration/infra specifics (KV cache behavior, latency SLOs, quantization guidance).

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
priya.m@acme-corp.com

Attachments: Acme_NDA_Signed.pdf, security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya.m@acme-corp.com>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + demo request / procurement gating

Hi Priya / Alex — thanks for the update and for sending the signed NDA. Confirming Mon Oct 12 works for our team. Proposed time: Mon Oct 12, 09:00-10:00 PT. I'll create the calendar invite once everyone confirms.

Marissa (cc'd) will lead the demo and cover integration patterns; Rishi will join for deep dives on performance and quantization. Agenda we plan to cover (30-45 min):
- Quick intro & use-case mapping (5-10 min)
- Live demo: deployment modes + routing/cost controls (15-20 min)
- Q&A on security/compliance and onboarding checklist (10-15 min)

If you have particular areas to prioritize on the questionnaire, send them over and we'll prepare. Meeting link to follow.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme-corp.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + demo request / procurement gating

Morning Alex / Priya — looking forward to today's demo at 09:00 PT. Quick ask: could you confirm the top 3 workloads you'd like us to demo (e.g., chat assistant, document summarization, search reranking) and whether you'd like us to surface cost/latency dashboards for each? That will help us tailor the live session.

See you shortly — invite includes meeting link and the joint agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
